_source: User adjudication 2026-05-20 (resolves Q-001), citing Rules of Play 1.3.1, 4.6.1, and Errata FAQ #1.
_note: Sail (4.6.1) moves between Ports of the same Sea or of directly-adjacent Seas; Irish Sea and North Sea are NOT directly adjacent (transit via the English Channel). Exile boxes act similarly to a Port per 1.3.1. Great Ships (Y6) collapses cross-Sea distance only for Parley, Tax, and Supply - NOT for Sail (FAQ #1).
